held_out_gap: Only exp05's four holdout tasks exist as held-out stock tonight. Enlarging the held-out side requires authoring new tasks of each construct kind (or registering curated ones) before any HAR-73 commitment; this proposal does not author them.
rationale: exp05's eight tasks are the only candidate set with (a) construct-paired dev/held-out structure already exercised by a Reef gate round, (b) plain-terminal Terminus 2 fit with tmux/asciinema preinstalled in every Dockerfile, (c) arm64-native python:3.12-slim images, and (d) fresh current-package oracle/nop controls from tonight.
Per-episode wall time is 56-119 s under a local 30B model (exp05 round 1), so a full gate decision on this pool is hours, not days.

Registry tasks with current controls can extend the dev side but have no same-kind held-out partners; adding them to dev without new held-out tasks would weaken the split, so they are extensions, not the base pool.
Heavy registry candidates (query-optimize, html-js-filter) stay reserve: their oracle/nop controls are valid but their 15-90 min deadlines dominate any gate round's wall time.
